test_name: Synthetic Test B: actual BLISS-recovered metadata
model: Frozen Synthetic-Test-A Stage-4 checkpoint and validation threshold
population: Independent synthetic injections passed through the actual project broadened-signal BLISS implementation on real Sweden-accessible backgrounds

primary_scope.conditioning: entries admitted to the BLISS candidate union
primary_scope.candidate_parameters: BLISS-recovered frequency, drift, FWHM width and S/N

supporting_endpoints: paired delta AUC Stage 4 minus transparent downstream filter
partial AUC and FPR at 90%, 95% and 99% TPR
one-station, independent-event and noise/RFI negative-case results

recovery_linkage.preferred: exact candidate-to-injection IDs emitted by the independent harness
recovery_linkage.fallback: one-to-one Hungarian linkage using recovery_link_tolerances frozen on calibration only
recovery_linkage.selection_rule: choose exact if stable exact links are exported; otherwise register frozen_hungarian before Test-B inference

pipeline_denominators: positive events entering the BLISS union
positive union events successfully extracted and scored
leakage_controls: calibration injections are disjoint from locked Test B
association tolerances are frozen on calibration only
truth and recovery-link sidecars are inaccessible to union, extraction and inference
labels are joined only after prediction files exist
no threshold or checkpoint retuning on Test B
interpretation_boundary: Synthetic end-to-end BLISS recovery plus conditional coincidence on real background proxies; not real Ireland-Sweden validation
